intro: Oil and gas from the Caspian Sea make up most of Azerbaijan's exports.

chapters.title: Oil and gas
text: Pipelines carry Azerbaijani oil and gas to Turkey and Europe through Georgia, avoiding Russia.

chapters.title: Beyond oil
text: Farming, carpets and tourism are growing, and Baku has spent heavily on landmarks like the Flame Towers.

keyTerms.meaning: The world's largest inland body of water.

cardGroups.title: Made in Azerbaijan
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Azerbaijan makes and sells to the world.
